limitations: Environment-only fixture omits spacecraft, GTAO, vessel lighting, portfolio interfaces and navigation animation.
Captured application camera positions have four-decimal and quaternion six-decimal DOM precision; fixture normalizes the captured quaternion.
Playing-sky and live screenshots are moving-scene observations. Metadata and screenshot operations occur sequentially; timestamps are not exact simultaneous raster boundaries.
Live orbital animation phases are not frozen for strict before/after pixel comparisons; use matched finite pairs.
JPEG screenshot files retain their native CSS pixel dimensions; browser DPR and drawing buffers are reported separately.
No timing, energy, battery, thermal, process-memory or GPU-memory improvement is measured.
